findings.title: Missing double-checked cache lookup under the write lock
findings.body: After releasing the read lock at line 43, multiple concurrent cache-miss callers can queue on the write lock. Once each caller acquires it, the code does not re-check entryPointAssetsCache, so every queued caller repeats the manifest file read (and any future CDN fetch) and overwrites the cache instead of returning the value populated by the first caller. Add a second cache check after acquiring the write lock for the non-Dev path.

findings.title: No concurrent regression test for the data-race fix
findings.body: This change introduces mutex protection for the shared entryPointAssetsCache global but adds no test that calls GetWebAssets concurrently. Without a test exercised under `go test -race`, a future refactor could remove or bypass the locking and silently reintroduce the race the PR is intended to fix.
